title: Step the calendar grid from noon so midnight DST changes cannot shift it
body: Fixes #13599. `monthGrid()` in `shell/plugins/panels/clock/Model.js` started its cursor at local midnight and advanced it with `setDate(getDate() + 1)`. Chile starts DST at 00:00 on 2026-09-06, so that midnight doesn't exist. Qt's JS engine resolves it **back** to 23:00 on the 5th, so the cursor never leaves the 5th and every later cell shifts by a day. The cursor now starts at noon (the issue's suggestion). So does the first-of-month `getDay()` that sizes the leading blanks, since that has the same hazard when a month's 1st is the DST day. No DST change can move noon across a day boundary.
